parts.html: The K-14 kitchen model is a contemporary minimalist furniture solution designed around warm beige tones, clean architectural lines, and a functional kitchen island.
Its straight-line configuration creates a cohesive furniture composition, while the island provides an additional working area and helps define the kitchen within a larger residential interior.

The solid beige finish brings warmth and visual balance to the space. Its neutral character allows the kitchen to complement natural wood, light stone, decorative plaster, and other contemporary interior materials.

The defining feature of the K-14 model is the combination of a straight kitchen layout and a separate island. The main cabinetry accommodates built-in appliances, practical work surfaces, and storage along one wall, while the island introduces a dedicated area for food preparation and everyday activities.

With a total linear length of 7.6 meters, the kitchen offers generous cabinet space and flexibility for organizing the main functional zones. This arrangement is well suited to contemporary apartments, spacious residential interiors, and private homes.

A distinctive element of the model is its combination of cabinet front materials. The upper cabinets feature acrylic-faced MDF panels, while the lower cabinets use HPL panels on an MDF substrate. The coordinated solid-color finish brings these materials together within a unified minimalist design.

A compact laminate countertop reinforces the streamlined appearance of the furniture. The main cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard, and the kitchen is designed to accommodate built-in appliances.

FREE FOLD Hafele lift mechanisms provide convenient access to the upper cabinets. Muller Profi Line soft-close hinges support smooth door operation, while Muller Box Profi Line drawers offer practical and comfortable storage.
Cabinet handles are included in the configuration. Pull-out cargo storage is not part of the standard model.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments, private residences, and contemporary residential interiors in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-14 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, architectural features, appliance specifications, and storage requirements.
The kitchen island dimensions, cabinet configuration, and working areas can be adjusted to suit the layout and functional requirements of the space.
Our services include personalized kitchen planning, material selection, cabinet manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
